t: The Mother Pathway has life, plant, and earth-related abilities. They also dabble in the field of healing and genetics, in terms of both the physical and the soul body. They can become the creators of new lifeforms based off current ones.

At High-Sequences, Beyonders of this pathway can induce their surroundings to flourish quickly and create chimeras/crossbreeds, ordinary humans, and various constructs such as golems. They can also deprive life force from targets and their surroundings to return them to the earth, rebirth themselves, and create life.
The Mother Pathway has an inherent affinity and possesses characteristics that help control madness.
The Beyonder Characteristics of this pathway originated from the Outer Deity Mother Goddess of Depravity.
The Above the Sequence of the Mother Pathway is the Goddess of Origin, and the corresponding Sefirah is the Brood Hive.
